## TestFlight manifest

Every PR must classify its eventual `main` commit. Replace the JSON below with
one valid payload. Use `ship` for tester-visible/app behavior, `exclude` for
process/docs-only work, or `release-operation` for build metadata. The merge
SHA and PR number are filled automatically after merge.
